title: Configuration code and bit representation
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $C$ be a configuration of $N$ on input $x$, and let $s,c\in\mathbb{N}$. The numerical code of the encoded configuration word equals $c$ if and only if that word is the binary bit list of $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
